_readme: M3 semantic-cache benchmark. Each intent has one seed (cached via the real pipeline) and 8 paraphrases in varied registers (casual, formal, panicked, terse, verbose, typo). Paraphrases at even index are the dev split (threshold tuning), odd index are the held-out test split. 'probes' are near-miss queries with a different intent that must NOT be served from any cached seed. Written by the M3 developer before any threshold was tuned.
